chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu us tɨɨgim gu Job; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu ma'nkam vaik ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't kɨɨv jix bhai'x kakneer vaik jix bhai'x jix ai gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu vaakax gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam duñia' gu takarui' gu vaak maa'n gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt vaik sɨspidhi'ñ na ba' jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhaibu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Job gu ñi'ook jix bhaan jix duñia' gu xibh gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bɨx; na gu' chɨtda gu Job; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu novɨ uañi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ suudai' u'va gio gu Sataan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' duukat gu jodai' kai'ch:―Dho gu Sataan gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' jiim gu ux.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu duukam gu Job cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p gu oidha' gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Sataan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Job gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham tu' mia'n gu vaak bɨx juraa'n gu bhóogɨt tu jiim gu noobh jix maa jix bhai' aa'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' muuk jano' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bɨx juraa'n gu oi'ñga'n tu' cham tu' gu suudai' gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx juraa'n gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' cham gu chuukug gu novɨ bhaan; jano' ba' jix buus gu Sataan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jugi i'i suudai' u'va gu vaak xibhɨk maa'nkam mar.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va mattuda' gu Job; gio ba' kua' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu chuukug mia'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sabeos jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' ka't gu ux a'gi'ñchu' suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu tai gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' kakneer gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu duukam na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ux a'gi'ñchu' suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu Kaldeos jix duu vaik gu chuukug jix maa bhaan jix ai jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu duukam na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ux ua'rgidhimɨk suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ mi'p jugi i'i suudai' u'va gu vaak xibhɨk maa'nkam mar.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jɨvɨl suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki naaka'n maakobh gu takarui' gu vaak jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koko'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu duukam na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Job jix búup jix duñia' gu kutun bhaan mo'o gu suudai' gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tɨbiaptuda gu ñi'ook vook gu naan tɨbiaptuda gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; jano' ba' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' cham jix duñia' gu Job tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' oi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan suudai' u'va gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' duukat gu jodai' jix aa' gu Sataan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' jiim gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu duukam gu Job cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p gu oidha' gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak cham bhai' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' bhaan na ba' gu takarui' cham kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Sataan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' zel gu ux zel bɨx gu chio'ñ juraa'n maa'n gu ux gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' muuk jano' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook o'o gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n tu' cham tu' gu suudai' gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu novɨ; gu' jix nukadham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Sataan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Job gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug mo'o.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx ka't daakat tɨjɨɨ'ñ maatai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu vaak gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' na ja'p gu takarui' ñiokda' no'x gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gio gu suudai' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' cham gu jodai' bɨx dhi' cham jix duñia' gu Job bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Job gu vupui gu Temanita gu Bildad gu Suita gu Sopar gu Naamatita gu chuukug bɨx dhi' cham bhai' ka't daam tɨɨtɨs maa'n pai'; na gu' gu suudai' gu jodai' jix ai tɨtda:―Aañ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui dɨr gu suudai' cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' gu kutun tu jiim oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham bhaan gu tɨkɨr.
Na gu' jix dhadhaa bɨɨx gu oidha' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tukaa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' gu vaak ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr dhi' jix kupi'ook gu Job gu chin gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Job.
Ba' jix aa' gu jodai' gu tanoolh tu' gu jodai' gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu jodai' dɨr jiix tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukgam ɨkgiga'n koi'm; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x na ja'p jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tukgam mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham ka't gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh oi'ñga' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jɨɨ'ñdhidha' masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Maldiiganla jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu si'avag gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu chuukug gu tasi' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu xibh.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob vook pai' tu' ka't tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham jix koi tu' dɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' bhaan gamai' vook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' kɨkbok na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na gu' jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu suudai' na ba' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx chiñia' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam na ja'p gu bhóogɨt na ja'p pu'ñix cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x mi'x dhaas gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ'; gio ba' tu duukam namkidhat gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix maa gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi'm cham gu takarui' gu ux jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' daam gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk bakia' tukga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ cham gu maa'nkar gu ux pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' va'k gu takarui' jupaabkamu'n gu chuukug; gio ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' choo'n jix duñia' tu' tɨbiap gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; gio ba' suudai' u'va cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Elipas gu Temanita.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu suudai'; gu' chɨkka gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' mui'x gu noobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug kɨkbok gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' jano' cham bhai' bhaan tu' tɨbiap tu' jix bhai'x; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' dhi' choo'n chotdonɨt nɨɨra gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jano' chɨkka mai' gu tasi' gu chuukug duukat gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' buupui gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' oraa'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ i'iich gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maavɨt gu ñi'ook maavɨt taatam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' maavɨt jix bhai'x jix koi gu ux uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam maavɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gio ka't tu' gu suudai'; gu' naak tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk koox gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' daam gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu maa'nkar bɨx o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ux vupui bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' vupui bhaan gu vupui tu' cham gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' chɨtda.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' ka't gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu duukam cham gu bhóogɨt cham gu takarui' daada'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook oo' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu xibh gu xumai gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx tas cham gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx suulhgidha' cham matda'.
Jano' ba' jano' jix maa jiiñak tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' jix maat.
Jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook daak mu'aa gu jodai' jɨɨgak.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook jootos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ba'bhak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam no'm jix duñia' tulhiiñdha' ki'ñgob ka't gu bhóogɨt cham gu oi'ñga'n namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jugi gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jo'ii' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu chuukug oo' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' duñia' tu'x gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p cham namki' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na jix maa dhuuk bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ux vaak ja'tkam.
Na jix dhaas gu suudai' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tulhiiñdha'.
Na gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu ñi'ook na ba' gu noobh cham xoi'kam cham tu'.
Na jix duñia' mamatdagɨm gu tasi' gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu jodai' bɨɨx gu tukgam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu kutun gu chuukug na ja'p gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu kuchii gampai' gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu suudai'.
Na gu' nɨɨra gu ja'tkam tu' na cham jir bhai' jix kup gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' cham gu takarui' jix duñia' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux tu jiim jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu noobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ux bopxi'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' cham tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' bhiogi' tu' tu jiim koi'm bhɨɨ'ñdham gu noobh gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug nɨɨn ka' dhix; na pai' dhuuk tu' jum i'obh chajaañ na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' chajaañ bhiogi' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jum i'obh gu vaakax yooxi'.
Na gu' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu jodai yooxi' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu vaakax yooxi' tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ vaak zel; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' mi'x juu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu vaas gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu vaak gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk tiriik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' tu' na ba' bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Job.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt jir bhai' gu ux gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n oo' gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' gu takarui' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan tu' gu maa'nkar i'i gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jugi.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' buur gɨ' kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu vaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax ju'ñdharan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu suudai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuichdha' gu ux gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu takarui' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt; na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt cham gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu jodai gu chuukug gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham u'ua'tɨdham gu jodai' gu takarui' gu suudai' uañi'ñ bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu o'o gu ja'tkam duiñchu'; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt choo'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jabook.
Na gu ñi'ook jix tónom gu chuukug gu suudai' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Temaan gu suudai' jix duñia' jup daam.
Gu' gu' jix bɨɨx duu jum xibhɨ'ñ gu ux nɨɨra; na gu' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu takarui'; na jix duñia' buupui gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu jɨvɨl.

Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Job gu Jawatan Dios gu Elipas gu Temanita; gio ba' daak gu tai bhaan tu' gook jugi; na gu' cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu' jix duñia' na ja'p tu duukam gu Job.

Ba' jix aa' jix bɨɨx duu gu Elipas gu Temanita gu Bildad gu Suita gu Sopar gu Naamatita jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Job.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu Job gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x bɨx tu'x gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Job.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx sɨspidhi'ñ bɨx va'k gu suudai' gu tasi' koi'mɨk bɨɨx gu takarui' gu vaak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr cham bhai' bhaan ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'; gio ba' maa'n jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix uam jodai.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Job gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨpɨ'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x kakneer gu ux jix bhai'x jix ai jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu vaakax jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu ma'nkam vaik ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jemima gu tɨɨgɨ' gookim gu Kesia gu tɨɨgɨ' gu i'ii'ñ gu Keren-appuk.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook na ja'p ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Job bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' jix maa gu taat gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' jix oidha' gu Job chamaam oo'm gu takarui' jix ñi' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
